why: Real shape fixed in PR #647: the BudgetPlan recorders test membership with the accumulator's own contains() once per name, and the accumulator is a CopyOnWriteArrayList whose contains and add are both linear, so one recording pass is quadratic in the batch's file count, which nothing bounds. Dimension 5 (code quality and algorithmic complexity) is the block that makes the added shape itself the evidence; with dimension routing on, this case fails if a source batch stops carrying it.
prTitle: fix(review): disclose files of failed and cut batches
prDescription: Records the files of a batch that failed every retry or whose response was cut, so the verdict can disclose them.
